@@ -101,6 +101,37 @@ jobs:
         working-directory: flix
         run: ./mill flix.assembly
 
+      # Shrink the assembly to the decoupled front-end (Lexer + Parser2 + the
+      # SyntaxTree/Token API) with R8, seeded by flix-parser.pro. Dead-method
+      # elimination drops the Weeder/Resolver/Typer/backend, which the parse
+      # path never calls. Requires the flix fork's feature/java2kotlin branch to
+      # carry the Flix-decoupling of Lexer.run/Parser2.run.
+      - name: Shrink to slim parser jar (R8)
+        env:
+          R8_VERSION: "9.1.31"
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl -fsSL -o r8.jar \
+            "https://maven.google.com/com/android/tools/r8/${R8_VERSION}/r8-${R8_VERSION}.jar"
+          java -cp r8.jar com.android.tools.r8.R8 \
+            --classfile \
+            --lib "${JAVA_HOME}" \
+            --output tools/shade/flix-parser-shrunk.jar \
+            --pg-conf flix-parser.pro \
+            flix/out/flix/assembly.dest/out.jar
+
+      - name: Set up Gradle
+        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+        with:
+          gradle-version: "8.11"
+
+      # Relocate Scala 2.13 into a private namespace so the parser can coexist
+      # with rewrite-scala (Scala 3) on one classpath.
+      - name: Shade Scala (Gradle Shadow)
+        env:
+          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
+        run: gradle -p tools/shade shadowJar -PartifactVersion="${RELEASE_TAG}"
+

@@ -21,10 +21,19 @@ fine-grained token that has **Contents: read and write** access to
 `wstein/flix-fork` and `wstein/rewrite-fork`. It is used solely to create the

-The workflow builds one generic, versioned `flix-vendor-*.jar` and one generic,
+The workflow builds one generic, versioned `flix-vendor-*.jar` (the full Flix
+compiler), one generic, versioned `flix-parser-*.jar` (the slim, R8-shrunk and
+Scala-shaded front-end parser consumed by `rewrite-flix`), and one generic,
 versioned local-Maven bundle on Linux AMD64, plus a checksum manifest.
 Consumers verify the generic files; they do not select a platform variant.
 
+The `flix-parser-*.jar` is produced by shrinking the Flix assembly to the
+decoupled front-end (`Lexer` + `Parser2` + the `SyntaxTree`/`Token` API) with
+R8 (`flix-parser.pro`), then relocating Scala 2.13 into
+`org.openrewrite.flix.shaded.scala` with Gradle Shadow (`tools/shade`). It
+depends on the flix fork's `feature/java2kotlin` branch carrying the
+Flix-decoupling of `Lexer.run`/`Parser2.run`.
+
 The generated Rewrite bundle contains the `org/openrewrite` subtree of a
 Maven local repository. It intentionally does not duplicate third-party Maven
 dependencies, which remain resolved normally by the consumer's build tool.

@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+// Relocates Scala 2.13 in the R8-shrunk Flix parser jar into a private
+// namespace so rewrite-flix can share a classpath with rewrite-scala (Scala 3),
+// which owns the same scala.* packages. Only Scala is relocated; the Flix
+// front-end classes (ca.uwaterloo.flix.*) keep their names.
+plugins {
+    id "java"
+    id "com.gradleup.shadow" version "9.6.1"
+}
+
+repositories { mavenCentral() }
+
+dependencies {
+    // The R8 output produced earlier in the workflow.
+    implementation files("${rootDir}/flix-parser-shrunk.jar")
+}
+
+tasks.named("shadowJar") {
+    archiveBaseName = "flix-parser"
+    archiveClassifier = ""
+    archiveVersion = providers.gradleProperty("artifactVersion").getOrElse("dev")
+    relocate "scala", "org.openrewrite.flix.shaded.scala"
+}
+
+// `gradle -p tools/shade shadowJar -PartifactVersion=<tag>`
+// -> tools/shade/build/libs/flix-parser-<tag>.jar
